name: What is the difference between asphalt shingles and metal roofing?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between asphalt shingles and metal roofing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Asphalt shingles are a cost-effective and popular option, offering versatility in styles and colors, with a lifespan generally ranging from 15-30 years. Metal roofing, while often a higher initial investment, offers superior durability, a longer lifespan of 40-70 years, and excellent wind resistance, which can be beneficial in areas like North Texas. Your choice involves balancing initial cost with long-term performance and maintenance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Asphalt shingles are cost-effective with a 15-30 year lifespan. Metal roofs are more durable, last 40-70 years, but have a higher initial cost.
